after_taxonomy.classification_basis: The city publicly distributed an AI-made Clocktower flyer without the required AI disclosure; this independently supports the disclosure-control failure. A contemporaneous report describes multiple striking one-to-one matches with an artist's earlier commercial sticker; the artist objected, and the city withdrew the flyer. These observations positively engage possible AI-mediated incorporation of an uncredited human contribution, but the model's source and any authorisation or attribution arrangements remain unresolved. Interested-party non-confirmation is not affirmative evidence that incorporation did not occur.

primary_classification.classification_basis: The city had an operative AI-disclosure requirement, yet the public flyer was published without the required disclosure.

secondary_classifications.classification_basis: The local newspaper documented one-to-one correspondence between distinctive features of the artist's earlier commercial sticker and the AI-generated flyer, including the clouds, trees, bushes, sun and palette. The artist objected and the city removed the uncredited image. This specific correspondence materially engages possible incorporation and human-contribution non-recognition. Neither the employee's attributed generic-style prompt nor unpublished production records establish independent generation; the actual source-to-output relationship and justified credit arrangement remain unresolved.

boundary_adjudication.material_engagement: A contemporaneous reporter described one-to-one correspondence in multiple independently specified, distinctive design elements between the earlier commercially available human-created sticker and the subsequently generated AI flyer. The artist objected; the city took it down and apologised. Such particularised observable evidence positively engages possible model-mediated human-contribution use and erasure, beyond generic thematic similarity.

unresolved_conditions.assessment: The one-to-one multi-feature correspondence materially supports possible incorporation, but the actual reference inputs, transformation path and generation history have not been authenticated. The employee's generic-style prompt account is attributed and is not proof of no incorporation.

unresolved_conditions.condition: The recognition loss is not adequately explained by an independently justified privacy, confidentiality, anonymisation, employment, agency, work-for-hire or equivalent arrangement that intentionally governs how the contribution is represented.
unresolved_conditions.assessment: The record does not establish a licence, commission or other authorised contribution-credit arrangement, nor definitively establish that the artist's contribution was incorporated.

unresolved_conditions.condition: Human contributions pass through material AI transformation or aggregation.
unresolved_conditions.assessment: The image was AI-generated and corresponds to the earlier identifiable artwork in distinctive details; actual human-to-model incorporation is still unverified.

unresolved_conditions.condition: Contribution evidence and actual credit or agreed representation substantiate recognition beyond technical recoverability of sources.
unresolved_conditions.assessment: The city flyer did not credit the artist and was subsequently withdrawn, but production lineage and any agreed credit arrangement remain unverified; no positive recognition sequence is established.

boundary_adjudication.decisive_blocker: The exact mechanism linking the human-designed original and the generated flyer and any authorised attribution arrangement are not established. Lack of disclosure of an interested party's production trace cannot establish non-incorporation, while resemblance alone cannot certify actual incorporation.
boundary_adjudication.resolution_requirements: Assess any authentic source/reference inputs, creation history, independent comparative/production evidence and relevant creative agreements if reasonably available. Proprietary model internals or a vendor admission are not prerequisites. If no further evidence is accessible, preserve the exact source-limited Boundary rather than misrepresenting it as disproof or a fully verified failure.
